scope: Product decision branches, grouped validation predicates and recovered algorithm state transitions; not instrumented JavaScript branch coverage.
sourceState: working tree; source hashes identify the reviewed snapshot

sections.title: Choose the kind of answer
sections.why: The app has separate ways to recall a good shot, suggest a next experiment, describe a saved trace, and replay recovered calculations. A calculated number does not become a machine command.

branches.outcome: Recall most recent comparable marked-good setting.
Run current-context, historical-evidence and sensory gates.
Describe saved full-shot telemetry and local feedback.
Validate isolated caller inputs and replay the requested calculation.

branches.condition: inactive plugin or failed host/storage dependency
branches.outcome: Return unavailable; never invent a replacement answer.

sections.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Request] --> B{Purpose}
 B -->|Recall a good setting| C[recommendation]
 B -->|Next experiment| D[suggestion]
 B -->|Describe a saved shot| E[analysis]
 B -->|Expert calculation| F[research]
 C --> G[Display answer and its provenance]
 D --> G
 E --> G
 F --> G
 G --> H[Operator decides what to do]

sections.title: Measurements, missing values and units
sections.why: A recipe is an intended amount; an annotation can be manually entered; the scale records mass. Keeping these separate prevents an intended yield from appearing to be measured.

branches.condition: shot is not an object, more than 20000 measurements, or non-finite result
branches.outcome: Reject analysis.

branches.condition: timestamp invalid or not strictly increasing within one signal
branches.outcome: Exclude sample and warn; machine and scale clocks are processed separately.

branches.condition: finite positive recipe dose and finite non-negative recipe yield
branches.outcome: Expose targets and their ratio; never rename targets as measurements.
Expose annotations with origin unverified.

branches.condition: last ordered scale sample has finite weight > 0
branches.outcome: Expose finalMeasuredWeightG; otherwise null even if an earlier positive value exists.

branches.condition: at least two valid scale samples and positive elapsed time
branches.outcome: Report mass gain divided by scale elapsed time in g/s.

branches.condition: finite measured value and target at both interval endpoints, with 0 < dt <=5000 ms
branches.outcome: Accumulate left-sample-held time-weighted absolute target error; missing values/targets and longer gaps do not contribute.

sections.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Saved snapshot] --> B{Object and sample bounds valid?}
 B -->|No| X[Reject]
 B -->|Yes| C[Order each signal independently; warn and skip invalid times]
 C --> D[Machine pressure, flow and temperatures]
 C --> E[Scale mass in grams]
 C --> F[Recipe targets and unverified annotations remain separate]
 E --> G{Final scale sample positive and finite?}
 G -->|Yes| H[Final measured weight]
 G -->|No| I[Final yield unavailable]
 D --> J[Descriptive metrics; no extraction diagnosis]
 H --> J
 I --> J
 F --> J

sections.title: Trace coverage and descriptive irregularity
sections.why: A missing interval is a gap in evidence. Machine inlet flow in ml/s and beverage mass flow in g/s are different quantities.

branches.condition: adjacent finite endpoints and interval 0 < dt <= 5000 ms
branches.outcome: Trapezoidal machine-flow integral; scale mass difference divided by elapsed time.
Count a gap and exclude interval from integration.

branches.condition: missing/non-finite endpoint or negative scale mass
branches.outcome: Skip derivative interval; do not bridge it.

branches.condition: at least five finite machine flow samples and >=2 seconds covered
branches.outcome: Report observed_trace; possibleIrregularity means at least one adjacent finite flow change within the same frame and a gap <=5 s exceeds max(0.5 ml/s, abs(current targetFlow)*0.5), using target 1 when unavailable. This is an implementation heuristic.

branches.condition: scale mass decreases across an otherwise usable interval
branches.outcome: Count observed weight decrease and exclude that interval from beverage-rate integration; do not diagnose a reset or puck cause.
Report insufficient_trace_coverage and null irregularity/preparation inference.
Return first 600 sorted points and truncation warning.

sections.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Adjacent trace points] --> B{Finite endpoints and gap at most 5 s?}
 B -->|No| C[Skip interval; report gap where applicable]
 B -->|Yes| D[Integrate machine flow or derive scale mass rate]
 D --> E{At least 5 flow values and 2 s coverage?}
 E -->|No| F[Insufficient coverage]
 E -->|Yes| G{Flow jump exceeds heuristic threshold?}
 G -->|Yes| H[Possible irregularity; cause unknown]
 G -->|No| I[No irregularity flag under this rule]
 H --> J[Do not infer channeling or puck preparation]
 I --> J

sections.title: Observed phases and inferred roles
sections.why: Recorded frame changes establish observation windows. A saved step name or volume-count boundary can label the window, but does not prove puck saturation. Programmed maximum durations are never substituted for observed phase timing.

branches.condition: any machine sample contains integer profileFrame or substate
branches.outcome: Prefer recorded frame/substate runs; do not fall back to explicit phase arrays for unmapped runs.

branches.condition: same non-negative integer frame and same substate, adjacent gap <=5000ms
branches.outcome: Continue run; at a contiguous transition close previous run at the transition timestamp; a longer gap starts a separate run.
Role outside_pump, without a pump mapping.
Role preinfusion with recorded_machine_substate provenance.

branches.condition: valid saved step pump flow/pressure at recorded frame
branches.outcome: Map saved step; role preinfusion when index is below positive integer target_volume_count_start or name matches pre.?infus/infus/bloom/soak/fill; otherwise extraction.

branches.condition: frame unmapped or unsupported saved step
branches.outcome: Keep role unknown and mapping unknown.
Use first nonempty explicit phase array in phases/phaseEvents/profilePhases/annotations.phases/workflow.phases order.

branches.condition: explicit phase has finite 0<=start<=end<=last machine elapsed
branches.outcome: Use recorded_phase_boundary; infusion-like name supplies preinfusion role, other roles remain unknown.
Phase unavailable; no schedule-duration fallback.
Report observed window sum; extractionElapsedSec comes only from complete recorded pouring-substate timing.

sections.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Saved machine samples] --> B{Any recorded frame or substate?}
 B -->|Yes| C[Split runs at frame, substate or long-gap changes]
 C --> D{Known non-pump substate?}
 D -->|Yes| E[Outside pump]
 D -->|No| F{Preinfusion substate or valid saved step mapping?}
 F -->|Yes| G[Label role and its recorded or profile-intent provenance]
 F -->|No| H[Unknown role and mapping]
 B -->|No| I{Explicit boundaries valid and inside recording?}
 I -->|Yes| J[Recorded boundaries; role inferred only from name]
 I -->|No| K[Phase unavailable]
 G --> L[Never replace missing timing with programmed maximum durations]
 H --> L
 J --> L
 K --> L

sections.title: Recording, pump and pouring clocks
sections.why: A file can include heating or a tail after pumping stops. Recording elapsed time, pump duration and pouring duration are reported as different clocks.

branches.condition: recording start and machine end are valid
branches.outcome: elapsedSec describes recording duration; it does not become pump duration.

branches.condition: state.state is espresso and substate belongs to requested active set
branches.outcome: Count as active: pump uses preinfusion+pouring, pouring only pouring, preinfusion only preinfusion.

branches.condition: first/last active observation lacks a nearby known inactive boundary
branches.outcome: Duration unknown; availability and observed start/coverage remain visible.

branches.condition: gap >5000ms, missing next substate, or non-active sample interrupts active span
branches.outcome: Window incomplete; do not publish a complete duration.

branches.condition: any machine sample was excluded for invalid, duplicate or non-monotonic timestamp
branches.outcome: All pump/pouring/preinfusion windows have complete false, durationSec null and timestampIntegrity excluded_samples.

branches.condition: both boundaries observed, no excluded machine timestamp and no gap/interruption
branches.outcome: durationSec is first following inactive timestamp minus first active timestamp.
Preinfusion extractionElapsedSec remains null, rather than subtracting guessed preinfusion from total recording.

sections.title: Control mode and the time-only advice gate
sections.why: Under flow control or a positive opposite-variable limiter, elapsed time can be a profile outcome rather than a simple sign of grind resistance. Saved controls, rather than profile title, determine the classification.

branches.condition: any saved step pump is not exactly flow or pressure
branches.outcome: Control mode unknown; title alone never classifies it.

branches.condition: positive numeric step.limiter.value and recognized controls
branches.outcome: mixed_dynamic_flow when any pressure step exists; otherwise flow when a flow step exists.

branches.condition: pressure and flow steps and flow outside preinfusion classification
branches.outcome: mixed_dynamic_flow.

branches.condition: pressure and flow steps, flow only preinfusion
branches.outcome: mixed_preinfusion_flow.
flow if any extraction step, otherwise flow_preinfusion_only.

branches.condition: only pressure steps without positive limiter
branches.outcome: pressure.
unknown.
Index below positive integer target_volume_count_start, or step name matching pre.?infus/infus/bloom/soak/fill; numeric strings are accepted for profile numeric fields.

branches.condition: any selected evidence control mode other than pressure or mixed_preinfusion_flow
branches.outcome: Abstain before taste-based numeric advice.
This controller gate allows continuation; all other evidence and sensory gates still apply.

sections.title: Current context and historical matching
sections.why: An old shot must keep its old identity. Current settings can fill current setup fields, but are never silently copied into historical shots.

branches.condition: current workflow field absent and useSettings true
branches.outcome: Allow configured current fallback and report userSuppliedCurrentFields.

branches.condition: historical field absent and explicit confirmedContext supplied
branches.outcome: Fill only confirmed missing field.

branches.condition: historical field already present and differs from confirmation
branches.outcome: Reject conflicting historical confirmation.
Profile execution identity unavailable.
Canonicalize selected execution fields with sorted object keys; display title is not identity.

branches.condition: comparison field missing on one side
branches.outcome: Exclude as missing.
Exclude as mismatched.

branches.condition: comparison field missing on both sides
branches.outcome: Report unavailable; rich suggestion permits this for beanType, roastLevel, grinderRpm, machineId and machineFlowCalibration.

branches.condition: known RPM, machine identity or recorded flow-calibration strings differ
branches.outcome: Exclude; unavailable optional metadata is not proof of matching physical conditions.

sections.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Current setup] --> B[Workflow first; configured fallbacks labelled]
 C[Historical shot] --> D{Confirmation conflicts with saved value?}
 D -->|Yes| X[Exclude]
 D -->|No| E[Fill only confirmed absent fields]
 B --> F[Compare identities, execution profile, recipe and units]
 E --> F
 F --> G{One-sided missing or differing value?}
 G -->|Yes| X
 G -->|No| H{Required fields missing on both sides?}
 H -->|Yes for rich advice| X
 H -->|No| I[Eligible context]

sections.title: Select evidence before suggesting a change
sections.why: The assistant selects up to six comparable observations at the current intended setting. More unrelated shots do not make a suggestion stronger.

branches.condition: current required setup/setting absent, dose/yield not positive, target outside (0,600], tolerance outside [0,target), or maxAge outside (0,365] days
branches.outcome: Abstain.
Skip.

branches.condition: shot age invalid, future, or older than EvidenceMaxAgeDays (default 14)
branches.outcome: Exclude.
Exclude; numeric setting strings compare numerically when both parse.

branches.condition: full snapshot context/timestamp differs from summary
branches.outcome: Exclude to prevent a mixed historical snapshot.
Require operator brewTimeClock (legacy default pump) equals target clock; use that confirmed time.
Require complete observed pump/pouring boundaries, or valid recording endpoints when recording clock explicitly selected; otherwise exclude.
Abstain; target is explicit and its clock is pump by default, optionally pouring or recording.
Exclude.

branches.condition: cache generation changed or plugin unloaded during await
branches.outcome: Fail stale request.
Stop collecting; history scan is at most 5 pages of 50 records, cached for 5 seconds.

branches.condition: stopReason matches error, disconnected or stopping.?backstop
branches.outcome: Exclude interrupted shot from timing evidence.

branches.condition: stopReason matches api.?stop/app.?stop and manualStopConfirmed is not true
branches.outcome: Exclude until operator confirms that the manual stop completed the intended recipe; never infer completion from a sensor tolerance.

sections.title: Taste, timing and uncertainty
sections.why: Taste supplies an operator assessment, not a chemical measurement. Tasting temperature and brewing temperature are distinct optional records. The engine never computes a brew-temperature correction from sourness.

branches.outcome: Abstain.

branches.condition: current bean catalog cannot be fetched/validated when evidence exists
branches.outcome: Abstain or dependency failure; do not backfill historical beans.
Return confidence provisional; direction only unless an owner-calibrated numeric step is available.
Return confidence heuristic, not calibrated probability.
Use controlled operator-selected taste label; sour contributes finer, bitter/astringent coarser. This is a taste heuristic, not a measured extraction diagnosis.
Map under-extracted to sour, over-extracted to bitter and balanced to balanced; this is the same operator assessment, not independent evidence.

branches.condition: flavour acidity, bitterness or astringency intensity supplied
branches.outcome: Descriptive only; no intensity threshold becomes a finer/coarser direction.

branches.condition: temperatures, descriptors, sweetness/body or sinceBrewMin supplied
branches.outcome: Store as descriptive feedback; no formula converts them into a grind or temperature correction.
Abstain and ask for preparation/extraction evidence.

branches.condition: both finer/coarser sensory directions, or balanced plus directional feedback
branches.outcome: Abstain on conflict.
Retain balanced setting or request structured feedback.

branches.condition: configured TargetTimeSec is finite and median < target-tolerance
branches.outcome: Timing direction finer; median > target+tolerance means coarser; equality is within window.
Abstain before collecting the advice cohort; no silent 30-second fallback.

branches.condition: sensory and non-null timing direction disagree
branches.outcome: Abstain.

branches.condition: sensory direction exists and timing agrees or is in window
branches.outcome: Continue to bounded proposal.

sections.title: Direction, bounded number and physical display
sections.why: A direction can be meaningful while a physical number is unavailable. A numeric proposal requires the owner to define one safe step and the usable limits.

branches.condition: current setting is not a plain decimal number; step <=0; sign not +/-1; bounds non-finite/not increasing; current outside bounds
branches.outcome: Keep direction-only proposal with warning.
next = current + step * sign * (finer ? 1 : -1).

branches.condition: next non-finite or outside inclusive bounds
branches.outcome: Abstain; do not clamp to a boundary.
Round representation to 12 significant digits; identify as one owner-calibrated step.
Keep research coordinate separate and explain withheld physical mapping.

sections.title: Recall a marked-good setting
sections.why: Recall returns a recorded setting rather than inventing an adjustment. This path has weaker completeness requirements than rich advice and reports unavailable comparison fields.

branches.condition: current beanBatchId, grinderId or execution profile missing
branches.outcome: Abstain.
Ignore shot.

branches.condition: historical confirmation conflicts, profile absent, or setting absent
branches.outcome: Exclude.
Consider; both-side missing fields remain warnings.
Abstain, mentioning history bound when truncated.
Return newest timestamped candidate setting, recordedValue true, sourceShotId and warnings.

sections.title: Convert a grinder coordinate
sections.why: Printed marks, clicks, mechanical gap and research dD are not interchangeable. A manufacturer step size alone does not identify an absolute zero.

branches.outcome: Return unsupported without algorithm/native coordinate.
Accept bounded signed 32-bit integer coordinate; no physical interpretation.
Convert um *10 to dD or dD /10 to native units.

branches.condition: unit does not match profile or stepped input not whole step
branches.outcome: Reject.

branches.condition: no native scale and no owner anchors
branches.outcome: Return calibration-required.

branches.condition: anchors identity/model/burr/epoch/unit mismatch, non-finite or coincident anchors, invalid bounds
branches.outcome: Reject.

branches.condition: requested value outside configured bounds OR outside interval spanned by anchors
branches.outcome: Reject extrapolation.
Apply affine slope (ddB-ddA)/(dialB-dialA).

branches.condition: inverse value falls between physical steps
branches.outcome: Return achievable false and warning; do not silently round to a hardware click.

sections.title: Host grinder records and owner profiles
sections.why: A model name describes a product family. The stable host ID identifies the individual unit whose burrs and zero were calibrated.

branches.condition: host response lacks a nonempty stable ID
branches.outcome: Reject UI save/load result.

branches.condition: local profile has unknown fields, invalid ID, missing label/model/host ID/burr/epoch/source or invalid anchors
branches.outcome: Reject.
Reject; updates remain allowed.

branches.condition: owner profile mismatches current host grinder, model, burr identity or epoch
branches.outcome: Withhold its calibration.

branches.condition: host create/update succeeds but local save fails
branches.outcome: Report failure; the already saved host record may exist.
Read settings back and require selected ID matches.
Restore prior in-memory profile/selection; report error.

sections.title: Feedback, bean dose and persistence
sections.why: Feedback is kept beside a shot. The dose captured on an auxiliary bean scale is only accepted with explicit operator confirmation and source identity.

branches.condition: flavour intensity outside 0..5, temperatures outside 0..150 C, sinceBrewMin outside 0..10080, unsupported field or invalid descriptor list
branches.outcome: Reject feedback; descriptors limited 12 entries each 64 characters.

branches.condition: measured bean dose lacks auxiliary role, beans purpose, grams unit, positive finite weight, deviceId, valid ISO timestamps or userConfirmed true
branches.outcome: Reject; sampleTimestamp can explicitly be null.

branches.condition: confirmed context conflicts with saved shot
branches.outcome: Reject.

branches.condition: brewTimeClock without valid brewTimeSec, unsupported clock, or non-boolean manualStopConfirmed
branches.outcome: Reject; legacy time feedback without clock migrates to pump.
Validate controlled taste labels and explicit under-extracted/over-extracted/balanced/uncertain overall assessment; descriptive intensities do not supply intent.
Persist brewTimeSec, brewTimeClock and boolean manualStopConfirmed; manual-stop confirmation is separate from elapsed time.
Serialize writes; change cache generation; await host storage acknowledgment before saved:true.

branches.condition: storage read invalid, write/read times out after 5000ms, or plugin unloaded
branches.outcome: Fail closed; restore prior in-memory entry on failed write.
Do not recover the broken stream silently; reload is recovery boundary.

branches.condition: measured bean dose plus final measured beverage mass
branches.outcome: Compute beverage-mass / confirmed-bean-dose ratio, not extraction yield.

sections.title: Research request and isolated comparison
sections.why: These calculations replay a particular recovered firmware model. They do not inherit the rich assistant's context/taste protection. A valid calculation is not evidence that it is suitable for a physical grinder.

branches.condition: invalid object, missing operation/input, request >32768 serialized characters
branches.outcome: Reject research request.

branches.condition: operation other than manual without exact firmwareBuild and deci-micrometre acknowledgment
branches.outcome: Reject.
Reject.
Reject mixed state.

branches.condition: invalid timing integers, algorithm-specific history/state bounds, or non-finite/out-of-int32 result
branches.outcome: Reject.
Unavailable result for that algorithm.
Invalid result with reason; other isolated cases still run.
Computed per-case result and separate state; comparable is computational availability, not common physical meaning.

sections.title: GbS1 smoothing and commit
sections.why: Two separate decisions occur: update a candidate from recent time history, then decide whether to return it. Being inside the caller tolerance holds the previous result.

branches.outcome: Drop before incrementing remaining ages; empty history seeds four copies ages 0..3.
Keep candidate; no correction.
correction = clamp(-(32768/(central-5)^3+0.2)*(target-central), -5,5); singular central 5 rejects.

branches.condition: continuous outside previous quantized +/-0.16 um, or no previous quantized value
branches.outcome: Quantize to 0.2 um using half-away rounding; continuous lower bound 1 um.

branches.condition: absolute raw timing error >= caller tolerance
branches.outcome: Commit candidate; equality commits.
Return previous committed result, initialized from estimatedDdDum.

sections.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Age history and append current time] --> B[Sort and average central pair]
 B --> C{Central error greater than 0.5 s?}
 C -->|No| D[Keep candidate]
 C -->|Yes| E[Bound correction to plus or minus 5; floor continuous at 1]
 E --> F{Beyond 0.16 hysteresis or first quantization?}
 F -->|Yes| G[Quantize to 0.2 um]
 F -->|No| D
 G --> H{Raw error at least tolerance?}
 D --> H
 H -->|Yes| I[Commit candidate]
 H -->|No| J[Return previous result]

sections.title: GbS2 regression and shared inverse regression
sections.why: The recovered model uses a negative setting/time slope. Its fallback and slope cap are replay constants, not a proof about every grinder.

branches.condition: input points count not 1..6 or non-finite coordinate/time
branches.outcome: Reject.
Use slope -2.

branches.condition: more than one point and x-variance >0.001
branches.outcome: Fit slope; cap any slope greater than -0.5 at -0.5.
Append current setpoint/time; keep last 6; invert fitted line at target.
Blend10% current,90% prediction with same-sign bounding; round output to dD.
Commit; otherwise retain last result initialized from estimate.

sections.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Append setting and time; keep last six] --> B{More than one point and variance above 0.001?}
 B -->|No| C[Fallback slope -2]
 B -->|Yes| D[Fit slope; cap at -0.5]
 C --> E[Invert line at target]
 D --> E
 E --> F[Blend current 10 percent and prediction 90 percent]
 F --> G{Raw error at least tolerance?}
 G -->|Yes| H[Commit rounded candidate]
 G -->|No| I[Return previous result]

sections.title: GbS3/GbS4 cancellation, phases and locks
sections.why: Phase selection changes how much of the recent fitted trend contributes. Startup holds and the special GbS4 lock take precedence over the ordinary phase boundaries.

branches.condition: previous target/adjustment exist and abs(estimate-lastTarget)>500 dD
branches.outcome: Cancel: update lastTarget, return previous adjustment locked, no normal update.

branches.condition: GbS4 error <3 s and history length >2
branches.outcome: Lock near and return prior adjustment; exactly 3 does not lock.
Near; reset hold counter (default 2).
Decrement counter and choose near.

branches.condition: otherwise error <=5 s, or GbS3 keepMediumIntervalWidth true and error <=nearThreshold+3
branches.outcome: Mid.
Far and clear history.
Append pair; keep last 6.
Initialize estimate_um*actual_s; otherwise retention filter(default 0.5).
Hyperbolic prediction only; otherwise regression blended 40% current 60% prediction.
Interpolate hyperbolic to linear with far 0/mid 0.5/near 1 defaults.
Commit candidate; otherwise keep previous adjustment.

sections.title: DdEff, effectiveDd, grindTime and starting wizard
sections.why: These helpers answer different mathematical questions. Their outputs have different units and cannot be ranked as competing grind recommendations.

branches.outcome: Return initial+[0,-200,+200][floor(calls/6)%3], increment calls; no timing/taste adaptation; state count must remain 0..64.

branches.condition: ddEff convenience helper calls missing or supplied
branches.outcome: Default18; explicit signed integer must be0..64; zero returns no values.
Initialize residue to grindDdDum/10 and return starting dD.
Require finite caller baseline; use k=ln(2)/1.85, a=1-exp(-kt), b=0 when t0 else 1-a/(kt); update residue with a, output baseline+(x-baseline)*b.
Return adjustedTimeMs null, optional false.
round((1+0.0022017*recipeUm)/(1+0.0022017*targetDum/10)*recipeTimeMs).
trunc(offset+coefficient*weightMg/1000+0.5): model coefficients E64 3.5/E65 4/E80 6; roast offsets light-20/medium 0/dark 20.
coordinateUnit unknown; never assume micrometres or copy into a native dial.

sections.title: Replay observations and separate algorithm states
sections.why: Simulation is an explanation tool. Explicit observations and fictional plant observations are labelled separately, and each recovered algorithm gets its own state.

branches.condition: invalid schema, unknown fields, invalid signed 32-bit values, more than 100 shots or input JSON over 256KiB
branches.outcome: Reject at the relevant scenario boundary.

branches.condition: first shot, explicit reset true, or any scope identity changes
branches.outcome: Create fresh algorithm state and reset current coordinate to scenario initial setting.
Replay that observation unchanged as explicit input.

branches.condition: actual time absent and synthetic plant supplied
branches.outcome: Generate synthetic-plant observation; otherwise reject.

branches.condition: setpoint or estimate outside scenario bounds
branches.outcome: Reject.
Keep raw output for inspection and clamp applied simulation setting separately; this is not the rich suggestion path.
Consume time/coordinate/tolerance; report beanType, roastLevel, taste and flavour as ignored by the recovered arithmetic.
Run the shipped plugin against mock pressure-profile records, explicit pump-clock feedback and an isolated mock host; this exercises software logic, not hardware.
Accept only under-extracted, over-extracted, balanced or uncertain; never derive overall assessment from sour/bitter/astringent labels.
Simulator labels it as synthetic or caller-supplied pump duration; it is not a measured machine clock.

sections.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Validated scenario] --> B[Start separate state for each algorithm]
 B --> C{First shot, explicit reset or changed scope?}
 C -->|Yes| D[Fresh state and initial setting]
 C -->|No| E[Continue prior state]
 D --> F{Explicit observed time?}
 E --> F
 F -->|Yes| G[Use recorded input]
 F -->|No| H{Synthetic plant available?}
 H -->|No| X[Reject]
 H -->|Yes| I[Generate labelled fictional observation]
 G --> J[Run shipped algorithm]
 I --> J
 J --> K[Retain raw result; bound applied simulator setting]

sections.title: Reviewed facts and photo rights
sections.why: A reference can explain a grinder or coffee without changing a recommendation. A link to a photograph is not permission to embed that photograph.

branches.outcome: Return scoped offline references, deduplicated by source ID; reference facts do not change the suggestion.

branches.condition: reference URL is not credential-free HTTPS
branches.outcome: Do not make it a usable external source link.

branches.condition: photo renderAllowed is true, safe HTTPS URL/license URL exist, and license is allowlisted reusable
branches.outcome: Display the photo with attribution/license.

branches.condition: photo rights unverified or URL invalid
branches.outcome: Use a local schematic where the UI supports it; retain source link rather than embedding the image.

branches.condition: external allowed image fails to load in simulator
branches.outcome: Fall back to the repository schematic.
Display research/recorded coordinate and unavailable conversion explanation.

sections.title: Offline coffee catalog normalization
sections.why: Catalog records preserve product identity and source coverage. They do not prove stock, roast freshness, a recommended grind, or species. Missing facts remain unknown.

branches.condition: Shopify export lacks products list or source URL is not credential-free HTTPS
branches.outcome: Reject.

branches.condition: Shopify record lacks title/handle or product_type is not kaffee/coffee/café/cafe
branches.outcome: Skip record.

branches.condition: Shopify tags identify green coffee, bundle, capsule or ground coffee
branches.outcome: Classify that form; otherwise keep format unknown. Bundle also includes an abo substring in the title.

branches.condition: JSON-LD record is not Product/ProductGroup or lacks name/url
branches.outcome: Skip record.

branches.condition: JSON-LD name/URL contains set, capsule/kapsel, drip bag, cold brew, cascara, advent calendar/adventskalender, multipack, probierset, entdecker or geschenkabo
branches.outcome: Classify capsule when capsule/kapsel appears, otherwise bundle; unmatched records remain unknown.
Set beanEligible true only for whole-bean; parser default unknown is false. Reviewed catalog enrichment is distinct from this conservative parser.
Set true; absence remains null.

branches.condition: invalid envelope/schema, duplicate IDs, unsafe URL, invalid category/form/eligibility or missing source link
branches.outcome: Reject catalog.
Replace that source and its products; retain other sources; validate before writing.
Compare deterministic serialization and fail drift without changing file.

sections.mermaid:
flowchart TD
A[Offline source export] --> B{Shopify or JSON-LD?}
 B -->|Shopify| C[Require coffee product type, title and handle]
 B -->|JSON-LD| D[Require Product or ProductGroup with name and URL]
 C --> E[Apply source-specific product-form rules]
 D --> E
 E --> F[Preserve known facts; unknown values stay null]
 F --> G{Catalog schema, identities and safe URLs valid?}
 G -->|No| X[Reject]
 G -->|Yes| H{Check mode?}
 H -->|Yes| I[Verify deterministic representation]
 H -->|No| J[Write validated offline catalog]

sections.title: Four steps and Simple/Expert presentation
sections.why: The wizard controls which task panel is visible. Simple and Expert change how much detail is shown; changing presentation mode does not make evidence more reliable.

branches.condition: Back, Next or direct step selected
branches.outcome: Clamp step to 1..4 and hide other step panels; update aria-current and step status.
Disable Back.
Remain at results; do not wrap or mutate experiment.
Show expert-panel elements and update aria-pressed/help text; Simple hides them.
Persist simple/expert preference in localStorage when available; simple-mode CSS hides expert-only elements.
Reset experiment rather than mix algorithm histories.

branches.condition: setup context or individual grinder changes
branches.outcome: Reset affected experiment so observations are not silently reassigned to new equipment/beans.
Expose model/roast/dose input for proposedDd; label unknown output unit.

sections.title: Manual DF54/DF64 experiment
sections.why: This helper accepts a caller-selected time target and explicit taste intent. It does not diagnose extraction from arbitrary prose or infer that acidity is undesirable.

branches.condition: profile not df54/df64_gen1/df64_gen2; invalid positive target/actual time or non-negative tolerance; invalid direction/sign/step/range
branches.outcome: Reject.
Add finer time direction; actual > target+tolerance adds coarser; equality is inside tolerance.

branches.condition: trimmed lowercase flavor exactly too sour, too acidic or under-extracted
branches.outcome: Add finer sensory-test direction.

branches.condition: flavor exactly too bitter, too astringent or over-extracted
branches.outcome: Add coarser sensory-test direction.

branches.condition: other free text, including bare sour/bitter or negation
branches.outcome: Ignore as taste evidence; an out-of-window time signal can still supply a direction.

branches.condition: flavor balanced OR conflicting finer/coarser directions OR no direction
branches.outcome: Return direction none.
Return confidence heuristic; legacyScore is 0.55 plus 0.15 per extra agreeing reason capped 0.9, explicitly not probability.

branches.condition: direction plus currentDial, positive stepMarks and numericFinerDelta +/-1
branches.outcome: Calculate one numeric step; DF64 reference interval is 0..90.
Withhold proposedDial and explain; keep directional result.
DF54 default finer counterclockwise; DF64 default finer clockwise; explicit valid override wins; coarser reverses it.

sections.title: Import a simulator experiment
sections.why: An imported experiment carries its own historical grinder identity and recipe. Validation protects those associations before replaying the recovered calculations.

branches.outcome: Do nothing.

branches.condition: file >256KiB, invalid JSON, version !=1, unknown envelope/setup/shot fields or more than 100 shots
branches.outcome: Reject import.

Reject: target 1..600 s; start 0..100000 integer dD; tolerance 0..60 s; plant 0.2..2; noise 0..10; pressure 0..15 bar; flow 0..20; dose 1..100 g; yield 1..200 g; optional preinfusion 0..30 s and pressure 0..15 bar.

branches.condition: required setup text empty/too long, unsupported algorithm/mode, invalid calibration or current native mapping
branches.outcome: Reject.
Require 1..100 valid profiles, unique IDs, no conflicting existing same-ID unit and active ID present in imported list.

Reject: integer setting 0..100000; target 1..600; actual empty planned row or 0.1..600 s; valid pressure/flow/phase fields; controlled taste and optional explicit overall assessment enums; bounded historical context.
Bind it to imported activeGrinderInstanceId, imported grinderId or current active ID before validation.
Preflight the completed rows through simulationEngine.run before applying setup/profiles.
Reject without applying imported setup or profiles.
Apply imported setup/profiles, bind selected calibration and replay completed rows.

branches.condition: imported or existing active profile is absent
branches.outcome: Use first available profile under current import code.

sections.title: Preview and explicitly import a coffee
sections.why: A product reference is not a bean batch. The host import previews the record, asks for missing product facts, checks existing records, and confirms the saved identity.

branches.condition: native catalog load fails or products is not an array
branches.outcome: Show unavailable or no entries; no bean write.
Native and simulator show10 more matches at a time; native search covers name, publisher, origin, process and format.
Show preview only; do not POST.

branches.condition: format is capsule, ready-to-drink, bundle, green-bean or ground
branches.outcome: Disable host import as reference-only.

branches.condition: beanEligible is not truthy and format is not blocked
branches.outcome: Require owner confirmation of roasted whole beans.
Require explicit yes/no selection; preserve original unknown and owner confirmation in extras.

branches.condition: required confirmation missing or import already pending
branches.outcome: Do not write.

branches.condition: catalog identity missing or GET beans?includeArchived=true fails
branches.outcome: Abort import.

branches.condition: returned host record extras.catalogId matches exactly
branches.outcome: Reuse existing record without POST.
POST catalog fields and source provenance; species/process/country/roast remain explicit or null; sourceOrigin stays metadata.
GET bean by ID; require matching ID and extras.catalogId before success.

branches.condition: host ID or readback identity missing/mismatched
branches.outcome: Display error.

branches.condition: simulator product.beanEligible is not exactly true
branches.outcome: Refuse local setup application; retain reference.
Reset experiment and apply available name/species/roast/publisher only; do not create a host bean or infer species from type.

branches.condition: published recipe reference is espresso-scoped with brewTimeSec
branches.outcome: Separate starting-point button applies available dose/yield/time; ranges use arithmetic midpoint and absent fields stay unchanged.

sections.title: Display measured evidence and independent comparisons
sections.why: The graph keeps each sensor in its own units. Profile references explain a recipe family without replacing the saved controller. Each calculation needs its own measurements.

branches.condition: metrics.trace has no finite timestamp points
branches.outcome: Show unavailable instead of drawing a trace.

branches.condition: trace contains machine flow, pressure or beverage mass flow
branches.outcome: Draw separate numeric panels in ml/s, bar and g/s; temperature measurements have separate degree-C panels.

branches.condition: sensor sample is explicitly invalid or next same-sensor gap exceeds5 seconds
branches.outcome: End line segment; unrelated sensor timestamps do not break the line.
Shade its recorded boundaries and list phase source; no scheduled duration becomes observed shading.
Display family, controls, maximum durations, exits and pinned source; saved shot steps remain authoritative.
Omit that calculation case; missing required inputs remain unavailable or invalid.
Build isolated inputs; proposedDd converts dose grams to weightMg; inverseRegression uses two entered points; effectiveDd has separate residue state.

branches.condition: imported shot used for recovered comparisons
branches.outcome: Require integer current coordinate with explicit deci-micrometre unit and positive selected-clock time before constructing GbS1–4/DdEff cases.

branches.condition: synthetic completed rows used for comparisons
branches.outcome: Replay each algorithm independently to construct its state before the final shot.
Display status and reason.
Show calculation-specific units and result with expandable raw inputs/state; wizard output unit remains unknown.

branches.condition: evidence changes or async response generation is stale
branches.outcome: Invalidate previous assistant result; stale result does not overwrite the new evidence.

sections.title: Import an actual saved shot and feedback
sections.why: A real saved shot is a separate evidence source from fictional simulator passes. Its controller steps and timestamps are analysed by the same metrics factory as the plugin.

branches.outcome: Do nothing.

branches.condition: file exceeds4MiB, cannot be read, invalid JSON/object/timestamp, measurements missing or more than 20000
branches.outcome: Reject; retain existing imported trace.

branches.condition: createBrewMetrics.analyze yields no timestamped trace points
branches.outcome: Reject; retain existing trace.
Reject: unsupported taste/overall, tasting temperature outside 0..150 C, delay outside 0..10080 minutes, brew time not positive <=600 seconds, unsupported clock or non-boolean manualStopConfirmed.

branches.condition: validation succeeds and import generation is still current
branches.outcome: Retain actual saved shot; render metrics; restore valid feedback; leave synthetic pass history separate.

branches.condition: selected clock pump/pouring is complete, or recording has finite duration
branches.outcome: Prefill corresponding measured duration.
Leave time input blank; do not replace it with recording duration.
Restore it with brewTimeClock, default legacy pump.

branches.condition: manual-stop checkbox or saved feedback confirmation
branches.outcome: Restore, export and submit boolean manualStopConfirmed separately from time; clear resets it and edits invalidate prior assessment.
Use shipped plugin with isolated mock host holding actual saved workflow/shot and explicit feedback; missing host bean/calibration stays unavailable.

branches.condition: clear, reset or newer import occurs while async work is pending
branches.outcome: Invalidate generation; ignore stale import/assistant completion.
Download actual shot and current feedback together as JSON.
